ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), NOT(ISBLANK(RES_Tax_Number__c)), OR( LEN(RES_Tax_Number__c) <> 15, LEFT(RES_Tax_Number__c, 1) <> "3", RIGHT(RES_Tax_Number__c, 1) <> "3" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax Number must be 15 digits, starting and ending with "3".
